title: Fed Rate Decision Tomorrow: Market Prices ~90% Chance of 25bp Hike to 3.75-4.00%
summary: The Federal Reserve is set to announce its rate decision on Sept 16 at 2PM ET. Markets via CME FedWatch are pricing approximately 90% probability of a 25bp hike, which would bring the fed funds rate to 3.75-4.00%, as Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech and elevated CPI data reinforced expectations.
why: 加息落地将直接压制估值倍数；sell put 隐含波动率在决议前一日处于高位，若加息已完全定价则决议后 IV 将急速收缩，需评估跨日 vega 风险。港股对美联储利率高度敏感，持仓腾讯/阿里/美团等均受影响。

title: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Briefly Hits 5.01%, Highest Since 2023
summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield briefly touched 5.01% on Sept 14, its highest level since 2023, driven by persistent inflation concerns and rising expectations of a Fed rate hike. Elevated long-end yields increase discount rates for growth stocks globally.
why: 10年期美债利率突破5%是估值压制的关键阈值，直接影响高PE成长股（英伟达、谷歌、Palantir等）折现率；sell put 端需重新评估 delta 暴露，港股科技板块（腾讯0700/阿里9988/小米1810）短期承压。

title: US August CPI +3.4% YoY, Core +2.4% — Slightly Above Expectations
summary: US August CPI rose 0.4% month-over-month and 3.4% year-over-year, while core CPI gained 0.3% MoM and 2.4% YoY, both slightly above consensus forecasts. The hotter-than-expected reading cemented Fed rate hike expectations for the Sept 16 FOMC meeting.
why: 延续报道：8月CPI数据是本周FOMC加息决定的核心依据，联储会议期间仍在发酵。通胀高于预期强化了加息预期，加剧美债收益率上行压力，对估值端形成持续压制；sell put 组合需关注高波动率环境下 premium 变化。

title: Brent Crude Surges ~4.5% Near $110/Barrel; S&P 500 -0.5%, Nasdaq -0.75% on Sept 14
summary: Brent crude oil surged approximately 4.5% to near $110 per barrel on Sept 14 amid continued geopolitical tensions, while US equities retreated with the S&P 500 down ~0.5% and Nasdaq down ~0.75%. Bitcoin edged up 1.9% to $78,500 as risk appetite shifted.
why: 油价飙升加剧通胀预期，强化美联储鹰派立场，形成股市双重压制（成本端+折现率）；能源价格上行对消费类持仓（麦当劳MCD/好市多COST/蜜雪冰城2097）构成潜在成本压力；港美股科技仓位需警惕流动性收紧风险。

title: Senate CLARITY Act Cloture Vote Today at 2:15PM ET; Passage Probability ~22-26% (Polymarket); Circle Pre-Market +~10%
summary: The US Senate is holding a procedural cloture vote on the CLARITY Act crypto regulatory framework today (Sept 15) at 2:15PM ET. The bill needs 60 votes to advance; Polymarket pricing passage at approximately 22-26%. Circle (CRCL) was up roughly 10% in pre-market trading ahead of the vote, though banking lobby opposition remains strong.
why: CLARITY Act是加密货币综合监管框架立法；通过将对稳定币/加密资产合法化产生里程碑影响，直接利好Circle (CRCL持仓)和比特币相关标的；失败则短期利空情绪释放。今日投票结果是关键催化剂，需密切跟踪。
